transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in today?

Well, I'm here because... I drive for a living, and dispatch and compliance have been tracking my route changes. It's through the computer system, and I keep hearing these little comments on the radio. People keep telling me it’s just normal oversight, you know, just part of the job, but... I can tell certain drivers are actually reporting on me.
When you hear those comments on the radio, do you feel like people are specifically talking about you or giving you hidden messages?

Yeah, they are definitely talking about me. It's not like they use my name every time, but they slip in these specific little comments about my route changes. It's like they're letting me know they're tracking me through the computer system. People keep trying to tell me it's just normal oversight from compliance, but I know what I'm hearing. I can just tell that certain drivers are using the radio to report on exactly where I am.
Do you feel that these comments or actions from dispatch, compliance, or other drivers are part of a coordinated effort to harm, control, or monitor you personally?

Yeah, I do. Like I was just saying, it's... it's all connected. Dispatch and compliance tracking my route changes on the computer system, and then the other drivers chiming in on the radio. It's not just random. 

Even when people try to tell me it's just normal oversight for the job, I know it's not. They are definitely working together to monitor me personally. It's a coordinated thing to keep tabs on exactly where I am and what I'm doing.
Do you ever feel that your thoughts or actions are being controlled by outside forces, like someone or something is influencing what you do or where you go?

No, I don't think so. I mean... I don't feel like anyone is controlling my thoughts or making me do things. I'm still the one driving and making my own decisions out there. It's just that they're watching where I go. Nobody is forcing my actions, they're just keeping tabs on me.
Do you ever feel that things people say or do in public—like things on TV, in the news, or strangers talking—are directed at you or have a special meaning for you personally?

No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. I don't watch a lot of TV, but when I do, it's just regular shows or the news. I don't feel like the people on the screen are talking to me or sending me messages. And strangers out in public... they're just going about their own business. It's really just the people at work, on the dispatch radio, that I know are focused on me. But outside of that, no, I don't think random things in public have any special meaning for me.

Have you ever felt that events, conversations, or actions happening around you—like things people say or do in public—have a special meaning that's directed at you, even if they don’t seem to be connected to you?

Um, no. I think that's kind of what you just asked, right? But yeah, no... I don't feel like random things happening around me have any special meaning. 

If people are talking out in public or just doing whatever, they're just going about their day. It doesn't have anything to do with me. Like I said, it's really just the people at my job that are focused on me, not strangers or random events.
Have you ever felt that people outside of your job—like neighbors, public figures, or groups in society—are working against you or specifically talking about you?

No, not at all. My neighbors pretty much just keep to themselves, and we just wave if we see each other. And public figures or big groups... I mean, they wouldn't have any reason to care about me or talk about me. Like I was saying, it really is just the people at my job, on the dispatch. Outside of work, I don't feel like anyone else is against me or paying attention to me like that.

So you mentioned that you feel monitored and reported on by dispatch and other drivers at work—have you ever experienced similar feelings in other areas of your life, like with family, friends, or other social situations outside of your job?

No, I haven't. It's just at work. My family and my friends, they're fine. I don't have any issues with them, and they aren't keeping tabs on me or anything. It's really just the dispatchers and the other drivers when I'm on the clock. When I'm off work and just hanging out with people I know, everything is completely normal.
Have you ever had any beliefs or suspicions that others would consider strange or not based in reality, even if you were not at work or under stress?

No, I don't think so. I mean, outside of the stuff at work with the dispatchers, I don't have any strange ideas or anything like that. Everything else in my life is just... normal. I don't think anyone would say I have weird beliefs or anything. It's really just the situation at my job that I've been dealing with.
Have you ever believed in something that others would say is completely impossible or not based in reality, even if it wasn’t related to work or stress?

No, I haven't. I don't have any beliefs like that. I know you're asking about it in a few different ways, but no... I don't believe in anything impossible or out of touch with reality. It really is just that specific situation at work that I'm dealing with. Everything else is just regular day-to-day stuff.
